description: Land Aquisition - Kirimetiya, Kandy Four Gravets and Gangawata Korale D/S Division, Kandy District Sec 05
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily focused on land acquisition for a public purpose under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of land servitudes, property boundaries, and specific land allotments for a water supply project, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) dealing with land and property-related matters. While a minister is named, this is incidental to the core land acquisition content and does not involve government personnel changes or detailed portfolio responsibilities that would trigger a government-related classification.
